Maybe a trivial question, but how do you fine-tune geom_boxplot()?

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/stat_quantile.html), but unsuccessfully.

(2) how do you tune the other two remaining quantiles (that also affects
the outliers)?

Many thanks
